routes: Tags API scoped to product FQDN

fallbacks.when: Use only for source tag metadata not represented by Wix Tags.

pitfalls.summary: Use the verified product FQDN and resolve tag IDs before attaching them to products.

mappingGuidance: Create tags via the Tags API (product FQDN), then assign IDs on the product's tags.publicTags for a public source taxonomy (WooCommerce product tags are public) or tags.privateTags for internal-only tags.
Source tag-archive URLs have no Wix equivalent; record each in the URL-preservation map with a redirect decision (category/search target or drop).

evidence.note: Catalog V3 product object fields for publicTags and privateTags.

Verified live: create + query-back readback, safe mode on — 2 tags created via POST /tags/v1/tags + attach to variable product verified; the fqdn-required pitfall reproduced live (400 without fqdn) before the fix

notes: The Catalog V3 product object carries tags.publicTags, visible to site members and visitors, and tags.privateTags, which are permission-gated and merchant-side. A public source taxonomy maps to publicTags; internal or organizational tags map to privateTags. Tag-archive pages and URLs do not exist on Wix by default, so only per-product tag visibility carries over.
